sources.note: Not a promotion: the consumer app's per-side spread premium is asset-banded — Bitcoin and stablecoins 0.99%, most crypto assets 1.49%, small caps up to 2.49%. sources.name: BISON proportional spread by asset category (official bisonapp.com/en/costs retrieved 2026-09-05; BISON press kit 2026-01; verified 2026-09-13)
sources.note: Not a promotion: BISON's proportional per-side spread averages 1.25% for Bitcoin and Ethereum vs 1.75% for ALL other cryptocurrencies (the 1.75% headline in fee_rates.json). Modeled as pair-level 1.25%/1.25% overrides on the EUR-quoted BTC and ETH pairs; spreads fluctuate with market conditions and trade size. No non-EUR quote pairs modeled (BISON crypto trades settle in EUR).

spot.note: MEXC 0-fee program: all spot pairs trade at 0% maker + 0% taker by default (no opt-in, no volume threshold).

futures.note: 0-Fee Fest covers 100+ futures pairs. Eligibility is account-evaluated with volume quotas and expiry; falls back to standard 0.01%/0.04% when the quota is exhausted.

spot.note: FDUSD pairs: zero maker fee; taker charged at your standard tier rate (since 2026-01-29). Volume counts toward VIP and stacks with the BNB discount.
USDC pairs: zero maker with discounted taker (promotion, subject to change).
Zero-fee promotion on spot (margin) orders since 2026-07-14, end time TBD. Volume does not count toward VIP level; no fee rebates during the promo.
Bitcoin sits in the 0.99% per-side premium band of the consumer brokerage (no separate commission; same premium on buy and sell at every order size).
Major stablecoins sit in the 0.99% per-side premium band of the consumer brokerage.

Bitcoin carries BISON's 1.25% per-side proportional spread (vs 1.75% for all other cryptos); no separate commission, same spread on buy and sell at every order size; the quoted all-in price is valid ~10 seconds.
Ethereum carries BISON's 1.25% per-side proportional spread (vs 1.75% for all other cryptos); staking ETH/SOL carries a separate 27% reward commission not modeled here.
